title: Repeat Spring Q-series release and maintainer comparisons
description: Repeat 32 original-caller histories on published Spring releases. Check the direct legacy retry listener, JDBC zero limit, composite map, reactive SSE, reported release baselines and the JMS reply selector. Recompile the relocated retry and autowiring clients, try two correlated Artemis responders, exercise SseEmitter through MockMvc, and compile the original and later HTTP service factories.
expected: The 32 original-caller release observations, 16 separate published controls and 6 later-revision histories must reproduce. The result files must agree byte for byte, including source, bytecode, classpaths and the two JDBC/JMS provider controls in their respective fixtures.

steps.name: Replay original clients on published releases
Check release digests and observed behaviors
Run the later factory and release-specific responder and API variants
Compare exact results and class digests
